title: ByteBuffer 三游标：flip / compact / clear 的状态变化
expected_output:
=== write mode ===
  after allocate         pos=0 limit=16 cap=16 remaining=16
  after put(5 bytes)     pos=5 limit=16 cap=16 remaining=11
=== switch to read mode ===
  after flip()           pos=0 limit=5 cap=16 remaining=5
  get() -> h
  get() -> e
  after 2 gets           pos=2 limit=5 cap=16 remaining=3
=== compact(): keep the unread tail, go back to write ===
  after compact()        pos=3 limit=16 cap=16 remaining=13
  remaining unread bytes were moved to the front (llo -> now at 0..2)
=== clear(): reset cursors only, data stays ===
  after clear()          pos=0 limit=16 cap=16 remaining=16
  hasArray=true (heap buffer), data is still there
  read the very first byte again -> l
=== absolute get() does not move position ===
  position unchanged after get(3): true
